title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: IntelliFrame people labels name in-room participants
summary: The rollout dates, automatic enablement, licensing and configuration controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. One descriptive assurance goes beyond the evidence: retain the statement that no autonomous actions are documented, rather than asserting categorically that the feature does not act for users.

Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled

claims.claim: PassiveVoiceEnrollment separately controls express voice enrolment independently of EnrollVoice.
